title: Averaging bound for coordinate influence
statement:
Let $n \ge 1$ and let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function. Then some coordinate carries at least the average influence: there exists an index $i \in \{1,\dots,n\}$ with
\[
  \mathrm{Inf}_i[f] \;\ge\; \frac{I[f]}{n},
\]
where $\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]$ is the influence of coordinate $i$ and $I[f] = \sum_{j=1}^n \mathrm{Inf}_j[f]$ is the total influence.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
replaced:
For $n > 0$ there exists a coordinate $i$ with
$\mathrm{Inf}_i[f] \ge I[f]/n$, the trivial averaging bound.
